rawCommits.subject: fix(ci): add missing Z_BILLING_API_KEY to stable release build
rawCommits.body:
The secret was passed in release-nightly.yml but missing from
release-stable.yml, so stable desktop builds compiled with an empty
billing API key. This caused grant_signup_credits to silently skip
on every desktop login — no welcome credits, no daily credits, no
pro top-up.
rawCommits.cleanSubject: add missing Z_BILLING_API_KEY to stable release build

rawCommits.subject: fix(chat): plumb new-session flag through image / 3D / video modes
rawCommits.body:
Clicking the chat-input "+" affordance set `nextSendStartsNewSession` on
the per-partition send control, but only the regular chat fall-through
path forwarded it to the server. Image / 3D / video sends routed through
`generate*Stream` (and the matching server handlers' `resolve_persist_ctx`
which always called `setup_*_chat_persistence` with `force_new=false /
pinned_session_id=None`) silently appended to the latest existing
session, so picking a non-code mode and pressing "+" never actually
started a new conversation.

Frontend: extend `generateImageStream`, `generate3dStream`,
`generateVideoStream` with optional `newSession` / `sessionId` and
forward `shouldStartNewSession` + `sessionIdRef.current` from both
`useChatStream` and `useAgentChatStream` (also fixes
`useStandaloneAgentChat`).

Backend: add `new_session` / `session_id` to `GenerateImageRequest`,
`Generate3dRequest`, and `GenerateVideoRequest`, then thread them
through `resolve_persist_ctx` into the existing
`setup_*_chat_persistence` plumbing. Downstream `pick_candidate_session`
already prioritises `force_new=true` over a pin (covered by
`resolve_force_new_overrides_pin` in `agents/chat/persist.rs`), so a
stale `?session=` in the URL no longer wins over an explicit "+" press.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>
rawCommits.cleanSubject: plumb new-session flag through image / 3D / video modes

rawCommits.subject: fix(updater): eliminate ping subprocess so Windows update no longer flashes a terminal
rawCommits.body:
The previous fix (22694c181) dropped DETACHED_PROCESS so CREATE_NO_WINDOW
would be honored, on the theory that cmd.exe would then own a hidden
console which child console apps (ping.exe) would inherit silently. In
practice, once the parent aura.exe has exited that inheritance is not
reliable -- Windows can still allocate a freshly-visible console for
the child for a split second, which is exactly the flash users keep
seeing.

The settle delay isn't load-bearing either: by the time the script
runs ping, the NSIS installer has already exited (we just captured its
ERRORLEVEL), so its file handles are released by Windows, and the
subsequent `start "" "!AURA_EXE!"` targets the installed exe, not the
installer.

Drop the `ping -n 2 127.0.0.1 > nul` settle delay from the handoff
.bat, update the surrounding rationale comments to reflect the new
invariant (no console subprocesses in the script, period), and add
`handoff_script_has_no_console_subprocesses` to pin it as a regression
test. CREATE_NO_WINDOW and the breakaway-from-job retry are kept as
defense-in-depth.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>
rawCommits.cleanSubject: eliminate ping subprocess so Windows update no longer flashes a terminal

rawCommits.subject: feat(chat): stack error chrome over two lines and copy the error message in one click
rawCommits.body:
The end-of-turn error row was forcing the full diagnostic onto a single
ellipsised line, hiding the actually-useful contract-blocked details behind a
title tooltip. Stack the chrome instead: line 1 carries the wrapping error
message with a one-click copy icon, line 2 carries the Support ID chip plus
the Report bug button (and the variant-specific Buy credits action when
applicable).
rawCommits.cleanSubject: stack error chrome over two lines and copy the error message in one click

rawCommits.subject: feat(chat): wire plan mode to a shared spec-planning policy that blocks code edits
rawCommits.body:
Plan mode (`action=generate_specs` / public `mode=plan`) now routes
through `handlers::plan_mode` so the spec-planning prompt, the
read-only tool surface, and the hard-disabled code-writing tools stay
identical across the auth'd chat handlers (instance + agent routes),
the public-chat handler, and the dedicated `/specs/generate*`
endpoints. Cold-start sessions stamp the policy onto `SessionConfig`
(suffixed system prompt + `tool_permissions` off entries for
write/edit/delete/run/git/dev-loop tools); warm sessions still see a
per-turn preamble wrapper + plan-mode `tool_hints` so a session that
opened in code mode still gets steered into plan-mode behaviour on a
plan turn, and flipping back to code mode produces an unwrapped turn
so the model does not carry plan-mode framing forward.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>
rawCommits.cleanSubject: wire plan mode to a shared spec-planning policy that blocks code edits

rawCommits.subject: protocol: add cache_read_tokens + cache_creation_tokens to ContextBreakdown
rawCommits.body:
These additive fields let the harness surface per-turn prompt-cache
hit/miss counts alongside the existing bucket breakdown, so the
context-window popover can show how much of the conversation bucket
came from a cache read versus needed to be written. Both fields are
`#[serde(default)]` and explicitly excluded from `total()` /
`is_empty()` so older harness builds keep working unchanged.
rawCommits.cleanSubject: protocol: add cache_read_tokens + cache_creation_tokens to ContextBreakdown

rawCommits.subject: sessions: backfill cache token fields in demo ContextBreakdown
rawCommits.body:
Commit b65d13cf0 added `cache_read_tokens` / `cache_creation_tokens`
to `ContextBreakdown` but missed the demo constructor in
`sessions::demo_context_breakdown`, breaking `cargo check` on the
branch. Initialise both to zero so the demo branch still builds; the
demo response intentionally has no upstream cache data to report.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>
rawCommits.cleanSubject: sessions: backfill cache token fields in demo ContextBreakdown

rawCommits.subject: chat: derive stable prompt_cache_key per chat surface
rawCommits.body:
Pipes a per-surface stable cache key (agent:{id}, instance:{id},
tool:{project}:{tool}, devloop:{project}:{instance}) into
SessionModelOverrides so the harness can forward it to aura-router for
OpenAI-family prompt caching. Pairs the key with 24h retention on
long-lived project surfaces; ephemeral test runs leave it unset. Wire
shape is additive — older harness builds ignore the new fields.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>
rawCommits.cleanSubject: chat: derive stable prompt_cache_key per chat surface

rawCommits.subject: direct-http: attach cache_control + prompt-caching beta to Anthropic calls
rawCommits.body:
Adds `cache_control: ephemeral` to the system block in the Haiku
session-title and session-summary calls, and to the changelog
generator's tool + system block, plus the
`anthropic-beta: prompt-caching-2024-07-31` header so Anthropic
actually applies the cache. The media planner library only has a
reusable tool schema (no static system prompt) so cache_control rides
on the tool. The titles' system prompt and the generator's tool
schema are identical across calls, so every retry / subsequent call
benefits from the cache read.
rawCommits.cleanSubject: direct-http: attach cache_control + prompt-caching beta to Anthropic calls

rawCommits.subject: sessions + loop_log + dev_loop: accumulate prompt-cache tokens in usage rollups
rawCommits.body:
Extends UpdateContextUsageParams, loop_log RunCounters, and the
dev-loop streaming side-effects to track cache_creation_input_tokens
and cache_read_input_tokens alongside the existing input/output
accumulators. CachedTaskOutput's existing total_cache_* fields are
finally written; the loop-log summary renders the new counters; and
update_context_usage counts cached tokens toward context-window
utilization so a cache-heavy turn correctly registers on the
rollover threshold instead of looking artificially small.
rawCommits.cleanSubject: sessions + loop_log + dev_loop: accumulate prompt-cache tokens in usage rollups

rawCommits.subject: interface: render Cached row + plumb cache_read/creation_tokens in popover
rawCommits.body:
Extends the context-usage store's ContextBreakdown (and the wire shape)
with cacheReadTokens and cacheCreationTokens, and surfaces a "Cached
this turn" sub-row in the populated-breakdown popover variant. The row
shows tokens read from cache, tokens written, and the hit percentage
when at least one is non-zero; legacy harness builds that don't emit
the new fields default to 0 and hide the row. Cache fields are
deliberately excluded from isBreakdownEmpty so they can't promote an
otherwise-empty payload into the non-fallback popover branch.
rawCommits.cleanSubject: interface: render Cached row + plumb cache_read/creation_tokens in popover

rawCommits.subject: chat-input: keep textarea focused when switching models
rawCommits.body:
Switching models used to blur the chat textarea because (a) the
ModelPicker trigger button grabbed focus on mousedown by default
and (b) ChatInputBar explicitly called shellRef.current?.blur() in
its onOpen handler. Mirror the SlidingPills pattern: preventDefault
the mousedown on the trigger and the menu wrapper so opening the
picker and selecting a model both leave the caret exactly where the
user left it. Add a ModelPicker regression test covering both paths.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>
rawCommits.cleanSubject: chat-input: keep textarea focused when switching models

rawCommits.subject: fix(chat): drop new-session pin when user selects a session before sending
rawCommits.body:
The "+" affordance in the chat input bar arms `nextSendStartsNewSession`
so the next send forces a fresh harness session id. The pin lived in
the per-partition `partition-send-control` map (project route) and a
hook-scoped ref (standalone / chat-app), so it survived navigation.
If the user pressed "+", then clicked an existing session row before
typing, the next send still POSTed `new_session=true` and the server
minted a brand-new session id. `SessionReady` then flipped the URL
away from the clicked row, so the message visibly landed in a new
chat instead of extending the one the user selected.

Clear the pin in both hooks when `sessionId` transitions to a real
value -- the user has made an explicit "extend THIS session" choice.
Also reset the standalone ref when `core.key` changes, since (unlike
the project map) it isn't partition-keyed and would otherwise leak a
"+" press from agent A into the first send on agent B inside the
chat-app shell.

Tests cover the +/click/send sequence on the project route (plus the
image-mode variant) and both the session-pick and agent-swap cases on
the standalone hook.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>
rawCommits.cleanSubject: drop new-session pin when user selects a session before sending

rawCommits.subject: chat-input: open context breakdown on click, not hover
rawCommits.body:
The context indicator sits on the chat input bar; opening the breakdown
popover on hover meant stray pointer moves toward the composer kept
covering it. Drop the hover-to-open + click-to-pin behavior in favor
of a plain click toggle (with Enter/Space/Escape keyboard support),
and update the tests to lock in the new contract.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>
rawCommits.cleanSubject: chat-input: open context breakdown on click, not hover

rawCommits.subject: chat: make text selection visible inside accent user bubble
rawCommits.body:
The app-wide ::selection uses --color-selection (rgba 20%/10%), which
disappears against the saturated accent the user bubble paints with, so
copy-selecting text on a user message looked like nothing was selected.
Override ::selection inside .bubbleUser to invert the bubble's own
accent/contrast pair (skipping the widget-only variant that has no
accent fill), which zui guarantees is readable for every accent/theme
combination.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>
rawCommits.cleanSubject: chat: make text selection visible inside accent user bubble

rawCommits.subject: fix(block): avoid nested <button> when trailing slot has a control
rawCommits.body:
Block rendered its collapsible header as a <button>, and renderers like
SpecBlock pass a CopyButton through the `trailing` prop, producing
<button><button/></button> and a React hydration warning. Render the
header as a <div role="button"> with Enter/Space handling and
aria-expanded so the trailing slot can safely host interactive controls.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>
rawCommits.cleanSubject: avoid nested <button> when trailing slot has a control

rawCommits.subject: chat-input: drop noisy [attach] debug logs
rawCommits.body:
Removes the AttachmentPreviews render log that fired on every parent
re-render, along with the addFiles / handleDrop / handlePaste /
fileInput onChange traces and the panel-level setAttachments wrapper
that existed only to log. Keeps the warn() calls on real FileReader
failures and unsupported file types since those only fire on errors.

rawCommits.subject: fix: harness session open hang + false stuck-stream pill on warm reopens
rawCommits.body:
Five layered changes fix the "Local timeout reached" / "Agent paused
for Ns ago" symptoms that fired on warm-reopened chat sessions:

* Frontend (interface/src/hooks/stream/store.ts): setIsStreaming now
  rebases lastEventAt and clears stuckSince on the false->true edge.
  Previously the watchdog inherited the prior turn's last-event
  timestamp, so a send after >30s of idle rendered the false-positive
  "Agent paused" pill at T=0 before any wire event could land. Locked
  in with three regression tests in store.test.ts and one
  integration-shaped case in use-stream-health.test.ts pinning the
  user-reported scenario.

* Frontend heartbeat handling (build-stream-handler.ts,
  use-agent-chat-stream.ts): silently consume the new
  progress:heartbeat frames the server emits during long awaits,
  keeping the stream-progress clock fresh without polluting the UI
  with a heartbeat indicator.

* Server safety net (apps/aura-os-server/src/handlers/agents/chat/
  streaming.rs): wrap SessionBridge::open_and_send_user_message in a
  60s tokio::time::timeout with begin/complete/TIMEOUT tracing.
  Backstop against any future class of harness hang we haven't yet
  observed; surfaces as a clean bad_gateway with a user-friendly
  "please retry or restart the harness" message.

* Harness client unblock (crates/aura-os-harness/src/local_harness.rs):
  subscribe to the bridge events_tx BEFORE sending SessionInit (so an
  immediate Error message isn't lost in the microseconds-wide race),
  and wrap the SessionReady recv loop in tokio::time::timeout(30s).
  The previous shape would hang forever when the harness WebSocket
  closed early, because the function itself owned events_tx so
  rx.recv() never saw Err(Closed). The 30s ceiling sits comfortably
  under the server's 60s outer timeout so the more informative
  message surfaces first.

* Companion harness-runtime changes ship in the aura-harness repo:
  classify_ws_frame now splits None/Err/Close into distinct
  CloseReason variants with structured ws_transport_error frames sent
  back over the wire, and the Wave 5 / T1.3 WS_MAX_FRAME_BYTES /
  WS_MAX_MESSAGE_BYTES caps (64 KiB / 256 KiB) are removed in favour
  of tungstenite's 16 MiB / 64 MiB defaults. Those caps were
  artificially low for the Bearer-authed endpoints we run and were
  false-positiving on legitimate ~77 KiB SessionInit payloads.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>
rawCommits.cleanSubject: harness session open hang + false stuck-stream pill on warm reopens

rendered.title: Plan mode, prompt caching, and a tighter chat input
rendered.intro: Today's nightly rebuilds chat around three big threads: a unified plan mode that locks the model into read-only spec planning, end-to-end prompt-cache accounting from the harness all the way into the context popover, and a sweep of chat-input fixes that finally make "+", model switching, and warm session reopens behave the way users expect. Desktop and release infrastructure also get pointed fixes — no more terminal flash during Windows updates, and stable desktop builds get their billing API key back.

entries.title: Stable desktop builds regain their billing API key
entries.summary: A missing CI secret had been silently disabling welcome and daily credits on every stable desktop login.

items.text: Restored Z_BILLING_API_KEY in the stable release workflow so desktop builds no longer ship with an empty billing key — grant_signup_credits now actually runs, returning welcome credits, daily credits, and pro top-ups on stable desktop logins.

entries.title: "+ new chat" finally works in image, 3D, and video modes
entries.summary: The new-session flag now flows through every generation mode, not just regular chat.

items.text: Image, 3D, and video sends now honor the chat-input "+" affordance: the new-session flag and pinned session id are plumbed through generateImageStream / generate3dStream / generateVideoStream and into the matching server handlers, so picking a non-code mode and pressing "+" actually starts a fresh conversation instead of silently appending to the latest session.

entries.title: Windows updates stop flashing a terminal window
entries.summary: The updater's handoff script is now free of console subprocesses, killing the brief terminal flash on every Windows update.

items.text: Removed the `ping -n 2 127.0.0.1` settle delay from the Windows updater handoff .bat — that subprocess was the source of the terminal flash users kept seeing, because CREATE_NO_WINDOW inheritance isn't reliable once the parent aura.exe has exited. A new `handoff_script_has_no_console_subprocesses` regression test pins the no-console-children invariant.

entries.title: Readable, copyable chat error messages
entries.summary: End-of-turn errors no longer hide their useful details behind an ellipsis and a tooltip.

items.text: Reworked the chat error chrome into two stacked lines: the full wrapping error message with a one-click copy button on top, and the Support ID chip plus Report bug and variant-specific actions (like Buy credits) on the row below. Contract-blocked diagnostics are now readable inline instead of being truncated behind a title tooltip.

entries.title: Plan mode unified behind a shared spec-planning policy
entries.summary: Plan mode now routes through a single handler that enforces the read-only tool surface across every chat entry point.

items.text: `action=generate_specs` / public `mode=plan` now flow through a new shared `handlers::plan_mode` so the spec-planning system prompt and the hard-disabled write/edit/delete/run/git/dev-loop tools stay identical across the auth'd instance and agent routes, the public chat handler, and the dedicated `/specs/generate*` endpoints.

Cold-start sessions stamp the plan-mode policy onto `SessionConfig` directly; warm sessions get a per-turn preamble wrapper and plan-mode tool hints, so a session opened in code mode is still steered into plan-mode behavior on a plan turn — and flipping back to code mode produces a clean, unwrapped turn that doesn't carry plan framing forward.

entries.title: Prompt caching, warm-reopen reliability, and chat input polish
entries.summary: End-to-end prompt-cache accounting lands in the context popover, the harness gets heartbeats and timeouts that kill the false "Agent paused" pill, and a cluster of chat input fixes makes "+", model switching, and text selection behave correctly.

items.text: Wired prompt caching end-to-end: the protocol gains additive `cache_read_tokens` / `cache_creation_tokens` on ContextBreakdown, sessions and dev-loop usage rollups now accumulate cache-creation and cache-read input tokens (counting them toward context-window utilization), and a stable per-surface `prompt_cache_key` (agent / instance / tool / devloop) is derived and forwarded so OpenAI-family caching actually engages with 24h retention on long-lived surfaces.

Anthropic direct-HTTP calls (Haiku session title/summary and the changelog generator) now attach `cache_control: ephemeral` plus the `anthropic-beta: prompt-caching-2024-07-31` header so retries and subsequent calls actually benefit from a cache read.

The context-usage popover gains a "Cached this turn" sub-row showing tokens read, tokens written, and hit percentage when non-zero — legacy harness builds that don't emit the new fields default to 0 and hide the row entirely.

Fixed the false "Local timeout reached" / "Agent paused" pill on warm-reopened chats with a five-layer fix: the frontend stream store now rebases `lastEventAt` on the false→true streaming edge, the server emits 15s `progress:heartbeat` SSE frames that the client silently consumes, the harness chat-open path is wrapped in a 60s server timeout with a clean bad_gateway message, and the local harness client subscribes before SessionInit with a 30s SessionReady ceiling so an early WebSocket close no longer hangs forever.

Chat input bar gets a focus and interaction sweep: switching models in the ModelPicker no longer blurs the textarea (mousedown preventDefault on the trigger and menu wrapper), the new-session pin is cleared as soon as the user picks an existing session row or swaps agents (so the "+" press doesn't leak across selections), and the context-usage indicator now opens on click instead of hover with full keyboard support.

Smaller chat polish: text selection inside the accent user bubble is now visible by inverting the bubble's own accent/contrast pair, collapsible Block headers render as `div role="button"` so trailing slots like SpecBlock's CopyButton no longer produce nested-button hydration warnings, and the noisy `[attach]` debug logs on every attachment render / drop / paste have been removed (keeping only the real error warnings).

highlights: Plan mode now hard-blocks code-writing tools across every chat surface
Prompt-cache hits surface in the context popover with a new "Cached this turn" row
Warm-reopened chats no longer trip the false "Agent paused" pill
Windows updater stops flashing a terminal window during install
Stable desktop builds get their billing API key back, restoring signup credits
